items.headline: Gunra Ransomware Exploits Fortinet FortiOS, FortiProxy Flaws to Breach Networks
items.summary: Cybersecurity and intelligence agencies from South Korea and the U.S. warned of Gunra ransomware attacks targeting critical infrastructure sectors and organizations across the world. Targets of these attacks include healthcare and public health, financial services, government services and facilities, and professional and nonprofit services.
